briefing: Good morning! ☀️ Federal authorities have frozen child care funding to Minnesota amid expanding fraud allegations, affecting over 30,000 families. The founder of Feeding Our Future has been ordered to pay millions in restitution, and the House Oversight Committee is set to hold a hearing on alleged fraud in CCAP daycare programs. Somali child care providers have reported harassment and vandalism, raising concerns about the safety and well-being of these providers.
